title: Wealth Transfers Are Happening Later: Zentner
description:
Ellen Zentner, chief economic strategist and global head of thematic and macro investing at Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss financial planning, retirement, and the impact of growing life expectancy in the US.
